headline: Watch SpaceX successfully execute the first ‘chopstick’ catch of Starship
summary: SpaceX achieved its first-ever "chopstick" catch of the Starship vehicle. The "Mechazilla" launch tower successfully captured the booster. This groundbreaking maneuver was celebrated by Elon Musk.

headline: Magic: The Gathering is getting a Netflix animated series. For real this time.
summary: A Magic: The Gathering animated series, "Planeswalker," is officially coming to Netflix in 2027. This marks a firm commitment after an earlier 2019 tease. Roy Graham confirmed it's "really happening" this time.

headline: Work to replace old copper wire led to the FAA’s ground stop
summary: A nationwide FAA ground stop was caused by routine maintenance replacing old copper wires. Fiber optic lines were being installed at a remote FAA facility. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed the cause.

headline: GTA 6 Leak Seemingly Reveals Official Album's Full Track List Days Before Launch
summary: The full tracklist for Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album has reportedly leaked. This happened just days before GTA 6's anticipated launch. The leak reveals potential music for the upcoming game.

summary: Riot Games announced "League of Legends: New Dawn" at the World Championship Finals. A massive game overhaul is planned for 2027. Expect changes to the client, visuals, and gameplay.

summary: Grace Ashcroft's actress hopes for her character's continued journey in Resident Evil Requiem. She acknowledges Grace may not be a "Leon character." The star wishes for the character to have a long future.

headline: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
summary: Zelensky states the US suggested Ukraine cede Donbas for NATO membership. A US official did not confirm, noting "many ideas" are under discussion. This highlights sensitive ongoing diplomatic talks.

headline: Neets review won't be for the faint-hearted - and will test Burnham's appetite for a welfare fight
summary: A new review targeting the "Neets" problem is anticipated to be challenging. Laura Kuenssberg questions its potential for success compared to past efforts. The review will test Andy Burnham's commitment to welfare reform.

headline: Alleged Russell Brand rape victim wants age of consent law changed
summary: An alleged Russell Brand victim advocates for changing the age of consent law. Mia Latter, who met Brand at 16, proposes a staggered age of consent. She aims to reform current sexual consent legislation.

headline: 'Can you believe it?': SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
summary: SpaceX successfully performed a historic "chopstick" catch of its Starship rocket. Mechanical arms captured part of the vehicle upon its return to Earth. This marks a significant technological achievement for SpaceX.
